test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held on: 4 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank 5.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 1'** i.e. **'immediately'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"immediately" **implies that Harry recognized the voice of his childhood buddy without any delay or hesitation.
 
• **It suggests **that as soon as the voice called out for help, Harry instantly recognized who it was.
 
• The **word emphasizes** the swift and prompt nature of his recognition.
 
• **It aligns **with the urgency and immediacy of the situation described in the sentence.

Therefore, the** correct sentence** is: *There were two **childhood** buddies who went through school and college and even joined the army together. War **broke out **and they were **fighting **in the same unit. One night they were ambushed. Bullets were flying** all over **and out of the darkness came a voice, “Harry, please come and help me”. Harry **immediately** recognised that voice of his childhood buddy*
